scope: Owned synthetic HTML and actual JavaScript corpora; not general huge-site JS readiness
recovery: Graceful cancellation after 80 committed rendered documents at 160 pages; preserve finite 600-second internal elapsed budget and the cumulative external phase watchdog
page_cap_axis: 10001 real raw pages with 16 actually rendered pages, 9985 remain static; separate explicit execution
temperature_boundary: Native capture requires HTTP cache off and fresh browser contexts. Cold means fresh worker without priming; warm means immediate repeat in the same worker, not a warm browser cache. OS caches are never flushed.
